  **The guild addon for the Short Royalty of World of Warcraft: Forever.**

  Everyone's gear, talents, professions, recipes and raid readiness in one window.

  No website, no server, no uploads: it all travels over the guild's addon channel.

  [Install](#install) ·
  [What's inside](#whats-inside) ·
  [Commands](#commands) ·
  [FAQ](#faq) ·
  [Roadmap](#roadmap) ·
  [The look](#the-look)

> [!NOTE]
> **Used by the guild in game since launch (4 Nov 2026).** Each version is
> built against Blizzard's own Forever 1.60.1 interface code and tested
> against a simulated WoW client before it's released; what still needs
> checking in game is in [TESTING.md](https://github.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/blob/main/TESTING.md). The pictures here are
> drawn by the [browser preview](https://github.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/blob/main/preview/index.html) from the addon's real
> colours, fonts and layout. Item icons are placeholders; in game you see
> the real ones.

---

## 🧨 What's inside

| | What you get |
|---|---|
| 🏰 **Overview** | The guild at a glance: four numbers, what needs a look, raid readiness and recent milestones |
| 👥 **Roster** | The whole guild in one sortable, searchable list, with alts folded under mains and a raid-attunement view; for officers the **raid roster planner**: Raider, Backup or Social, Main or Off per role, level, gear, attunement and notes from every officer in one table |
| 🛡️ **Character** | Anyone's gear, talents, professions, cooldowns, attunements and reputations |
| 📅 **Raids** | Guild raids made in the addon by officers and raid leaders, from the **Calendar** (one or several instances a night, or "to be decided" until later), and **dungeon groups** (UBRS) anyone can make; sign up with your role and see who's coming, with readiness and who's **In** or on the **Bench**; **Groups** of five (drag and drop, **Auto-fill**, **Invite & arrange**), **boss assignments**, **away days** on a calendar; **Copy for Discord** and **Import sign-ups from Discord**, and our own **Discord bot** with sign-up buttons; for officers (`/sr officer`) automatic **attendance**: signed up and online at the start (on time, late, no-show, bench) and **changed sign-ups**, with totals, shared between all officers |
| 🎲 **Loot** (Reserve+) | Soft reserves with **bonus points**: reserve items for a raid night, and every night you don't get one it gains points (no cap) that are added to your roll next time; your points, everyone's, and a history of every change; for officers a **Loot night** screen (rolls ranked, award, raid check, end-of-night bonus) and **Rules** (reserves per raid, bonus, loot lists) |
| ⚒️ **Find a crafter** | Search an item or recipe and see who in the guild can make it, online first, with its reagents and your bag counts |
| 🧪 **Professions** | Three page tabs: **Guild** (every profession in the guild, then each profession's crafters and recipes), **Recipes** (**every recipe in the game**, by name, group or material) and **Cooldowns**; specialisations, favourites, skill-up colours from Forever's own data, and where to learn each recipe |
| 🔤 **Short Words** | A five-letter word game: **Daily** (one word a day for the whole guild) and **Free for all** (keep going), each with **Today** and **All time** guild leaderboards; today's word offered on flight paths |
| ⚙️ **Settings** | Sharing and privacy switches, accent colour, font, window width and size, and reminders; tools and a live status read-out under **Advanced** |
| 🧨 **Everywhere** | A sidebar window in your pick of accent colour, `/sr`, a minimap button, short guild lines on item tooltips, chat reminders and a copyable debug report |

### 🏰 Overview

![Overview page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/overview.png)

The first page. The line under its title says your guild, members, players
(alts counted once) and who's online.

- **Four numbers** across the top: **members** (point at it for levels in bands and players), **online now** (and how many with Short Royalty), **have Short Royalty** out of everyone (point at it for **everyone not seen with it yet**, online first; click to see them in the Roster), and **days until raids** open on 9 Dec (in the accent colour). Characters in the guild's **Alt rank** (any rank named "Alt" or "Alts") are left out.
- **Needs a look**: only what's actually missing or out of date: members not seen with the addon yet, anyone on an old Short Royalty, members who have the addon but whose data hasn't reached you, profession windows not opened, profiles older than a week. Each row opens the Roster with those people on top; point at it for names or an explanation. "All good" when there's nothing to fix, and a line when a newer Short Royalty is out.
- **Raids**: the **next guild raid** first (when, how many signed up and your own answer; click to sign up), then Onyxia's Lair (40) with a bar of attuned / not yet / unknown, and how many have the quest done but the Drakefire Amulet out of their bags; Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit (no attunement) on one line with how many are ready. Rows and *Attunement list* open the Roster's raid view.
- **Getting started** (new players, in place of milestones): open your profession windows (it names which), check your Character tab, choose what you share, and how many guildmates have Short Royalty. Ticks itself off and goes away when done, or click **Hide**.

![Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/getting-started.png)

- **Milestones**: level-ups (every 10 levels), profession 75/150/225/300, Onyxia attunement and new recipes. Hover for when, click to open the character.

The professions summary and the recipe numbers moved to the Professions
page (v0.6.0). Milestones are worked out by **your own addon** and kept on
your computer only (the last 50); nothing extra is sent. Turn them off in
Settings.

### 👥 Roster

![Roster tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/roster.png)

- **Every guild member**, including people without the addon.
- **Six columns:** **Name** with a status dot, in class colour (*(you)* in the accent colour on your characters, **+2** when alts are folded in, an orange **!** when their addon is out of date or their data is over a week old), **Lvl**, **Spec** (main tree), **Professions**, **iLvl** and **Seen** (*online*, *on alt* or how long ago). Rank, talent points, addon version and how fresh their data is are in the name's tooltip (v0.6.0).
- **Status dots:** 🟢 online with Short Royalty · ⚪ online without it · ⚫ offline.
- **Sort** by clicking a column (an arrow marks the sorted one). Online members come first.
- **Search** by name, profession, spec, class, rank, a word from their note, or an alt's name. A search with no matches says so.
- **The ··· menu:** *Group alts under their main* (on by default: each player once) and *Copy the list as text* (exactly as shown, for Discord; notes are never included).
- **Counter**: characters, how many have data, and how many need an update.
- **Hover a row** for rank, online status, talent points, every profession, missing enchants, the public note (and officer note if you're an officer), their alts, their addon version and how old their data is. **Click** to open the character.

**Raid view.** Pick a raid from the menu (Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit or
Onyxia's Lair, Forever's first wave) to see who's attuned:

![Roster with Onyxia's Lair picked: Attuned column and filters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/attunement.png)

- Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit need no attunement, so they just say so.
- For Onyxia, an **Attuned** column: *yes* (quest done, or the amulet in their bags), *no*, or *unknown* (no data, or gear hidden). An orange **!** means the quest is done but the amulet isn't in their bags, and you need it there to enter.
- Filters **All / Attuned / Not attuned / Unknown**, a count such as "23 attuned · 9 not · 6 unknown", and **Max level only** (on by default).
- Every character gets its own row, alts included, with "alt of X" in the tooltip. Your choices are remembered.

**Officers view: the raid roster planner** (v0.13.0; from the officers' feedback). Officers and raid leaders with `/sr officer` get an **Officers** chip next to the ··· menu: the static raid roster as one table, one row per player (alts folded into their main), with level, gear and attunement filled in by the addon.

![Roster planner: one row per player with status, Tank/Healer/DPS, level, item level, attunement, enchants, data age and notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/roster-planner-all.png)

- **Chips with counts**: All, **Tanks 2+3** (mains + backups), Healers, DPS, **Not sorted** (no status or roles yet: the people to get to know), plus Raider, Backup, **Social** (v0.14.0: neither, but sorted) and **Needs a look** (not 60, not attuned, missing enchants, no addon, or data a week old). "All" shows the whole guild in one line: players at 60, at 55-59, attuned to Onyxia, missing enchants, without the addon.
- **Columns**: name (+2 = alts), spec, **Status** (Raider, Backup or Social; not the guild rank), **Tank / Healer / DPS** (Main filled, Off outlined), **Away** in words ("9-15 Dec", "Every Tue"; red when it clashes with a raid on the calendar; click it for a **mini calendar** like Raids → Calendar, with raid days marked and the player's own away days outlined, and click days to mark them away), level, item level, Onyxia attunement, missing enchants, **Seen** (how old their data is; orange after a week), and **Note**. Click a column title to sort.
- **Click a status or role cell** for a small menu (Main / Off / No): no accidental changes. **Click a note cell** to read every officer's note (who wrote it and when) and write or remove your own. **Click a name** for their full Character page.
- A role chip shows its **mains**, then its **backups**, then **unsorted players whose spec fits** (an unsorted Prot warrior under Tanks); each group's header says how many are 60 and attuned, and who's **away this reset week**.
- **Sign-ups** (menu, optional): pick a raid and the Seen column shows who signed up for it.
- The Character page gets an **Officers** section (status, roles, away days, attendance, notes) and **Alt of** at the top right. Auto-fill on the Raids → Groups page puts Raiders and officer-set mains first.
- **Raider check** (v0.16.7, the guild's rule: Raider after 80% attendance over two months). From the officers' attendance records: a player counts as attending a raid when they signed up and were online at the start (on time or late), or were ticked Bench, on any of their characters; **ready** = at least 80% of *all* raids in the last 60 days (13 of 16 at two a week), at least 8 raids, and two months of records. Their Status cell then reads **Ready** (filled), the summary line says "2 ready for Raider", officers get one chat line about 3 minutes after login, and the Character page's Officers section shows "13 of 16 raids (81%)". Click the cell → **Make Raider (status and guild rank)**: sets Raider in the planner and asks the game to promote their guild rank one step per press (only up to a rank called "Raider", only if your own rank may promote). Nothing is promoted without an officer's press.
- **Taller window** in the ··· menu for long lists.
- Shared only between officers and raid leaders, by whisper: changes reach the others online within a minute, and the rest when they log in. Members never receive any of it.

![Roster planner, Tanks: mains, backups and unsorted tanks, with a role menu open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/roster-planner.png)

![Roster planner: the away calendar on an Away cell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/roster-planner-away.png)

![Roster planner: the notes box on a note cell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/roster-planner-note.png)

### 🛡️ Character

![Character tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/character.png)

- **Top:** *Back to roster*, *My character*, *Whisper* and *Ask for latest*.
- **Ask for latest** asks them (or their online alt) for their newest data. It works while they're online with Short Royalty, at most every 30 seconds; otherwise it's greyed out and says why.
- **Header:** name in class colour, level, race, class and rank, plus how old the data is and where it came from (*this account*, *from them*, *relayed by a guildmate*). Old data says *may be out of date*.
- **Paperdoll:** all 19 slots with item-quality borders. Hover for the **real item tooltip**, Shift-click to link it, Ctrl-click for the dressing room. The middle shows **average item level** in the accent colour, the main talent tree, and how many enchants are missing (an orange **!** marks each slot).
- **Character model** (the **Model** chip, on by default) in the middle of the paperdoll: drag to turn it, scroll to zoom. When they're your **target** or in your **group** it's their real look. Otherwise it's **their gear on your character**, switched to their race where the game allows (face, hair, gender and build stay yours: the game only lets addons show players who are actually there). Shows their item level underneath. Click **Model** again for the item level, talents and missing enchants instead.
- **Details** in two columns:
  - **Alts** and **notes**; **talents** per tree; **professions** with skill, recipe count or *not scanned yet*; **cooldowns** (transmutes, Mooncloth: time left or *ready*).
  - **Attunements** for the first raid wave (with the amulet warning) and **reputations**: raid and crafting factions first, then everything at Friendly or above.
- **Privacy:** hidden gear or recipes say *hidden by this player*.
- **No data yet?** The panel says so and explains why, instead of showing empty boxes.

### 📅 Raids

![Raids page: upcoming raids, sign-up buttons and the line-up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids.png)

Guild raids are made **in the addon** by officers and raid leaders (no
Blizzard calendar). Everyone with Short Royalty sees them within a minute;
people who were offline get them when they log in. `/sr raids` opens the page.

- **Upcoming raids** on the left (when, which raid, how many signed up out of its size; a dot shows your own answer).
- **Sign up**, **Tentative** or **Can't come** with one click, and your **role** (Tank, Healer or DPS: remembered, and guessed from your talents until you pick).
- **Who's coming:** name (green dot = online), answer, role (greyed when guessed), spec, item level and attuned, coming first and by role. **Role counts** ("Tanks 3 · Healers 6 · DPS 13 · 22 / 40") and a **readiness** line: no tanks or healers yet, tentatives, more sign-ups than the raid holds, not attuned, amulet not in bags, item-level range, missing enchants, old data, and anyone signed up on two characters.
- **In or Bench** (v0.10.0): officers pick the raid from the sign-ups, and **everyone sees it**: a *Raid* column (In / Bench), "You're in" or "You're on the bench" under the buttons and on the Overview, and the counts switch to the people In ("In 18 / 40: Tanks 2 · Healers 5 · DPS 11 · Bench 3"). Officers click a name to put them In, then Bench, then undecided again; right-click opens their character.
- **Discord, without any program** (v0.10.0): addons can't reach the internet, so it's copy and paste. The ··· menu has **Copy for Discord**: a ready announcement (raid, time shown in each reader's own time zone, who's signed up by role, In and Bench) to paste into a Discord channel. Officers also get **Import sign-ups from Discord**: paste the sign-up list from Discord (any bot's list, or names typed by hand) and the addon signs those players up, by role and tentative / can't come. Names must match characters in the guild (a full name, or a first name only one member has); lines it can't match are listed. A sign-up a player made themselves in game is never overwritten.
- The ··· menu also copies the line-up as plain text.
- **Our own Discord bot** (v0.12.0, `docs/DISCORD-BOT.md`): officers pick **Post with the Discord bot** in the raid's ··· menu and paste the code into `/raid-post` in Discord. The bot posts the raid with **sign-up buttons** (Tank, Healer, DPS, Tentative, Can't come; `/link` your character once) and updates the post as people sign up, or when an officer posts it again. **Copy for the addon** on the post gives the Discord sign-ups to paste into *Import sign-ups from Discord*. The bot runs free on Cloudflare; the addon itself still never goes online.

![Short Royalty and Discord: post the raid from the addon, sign up with buttons in Discord, import the sign-ups back into the game](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/discord-bot.png)

![The bot's raid post in Discord with sign-up buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/discord-bot-post.png)

- **Calendar** (v0.10.2): a month view with each raid on its day, coloured by your answer (green signed up or in, pink bench). Click a raid to open it. **<** / **>** change month, **Today** comes back.
- **Click a day** (v0.14.0) for the day box: that day's raids and **I'm away this day** for everyone. Officers also make a raid there: start time, and the night's instances (Barrow, Hyjal, Onyxia, one or several; none = **to be decided**), any time ahead (v0.15.1). The **New raid** tab is gone.

![Raids calendar: the day box with I'm away this day and New raid (time and instances)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-calendar-day.png)

- **Weekly raids** (v0.16.0): the day box's **Repeat** menu makes the same raid every week, up to 12 at once; each can be changed or cancelled on its own, and the raid's ··· menu cancels the rest of the series.
- **Dungeon groups** (v0.16.8): anyone can make an **Upper Blackrock Spire** group (10 players) from the Calendar: click a day, pick the time, **Create group**. It works like a raid (sign-ups, In/Bench, two groups of five, Auto-fill, Invite & arrange, assignments), and its maker runs it as an officer would; officers can change or cancel any of them. Each member can have 3 coming up at once. Dungeon groups don't count for attendance or the Raider check and have no soft reserves. Officers see a **UBRS** chip beside Repeat in the day box and next to a raid's title; a night is raids or a dungeon group, never both. Members on older versions don't see dungeon groups until they update.

![The Calendar's day box for a member: New dungeon group, UBRS, Create group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-calendar-dungeon.png)

- **Reserve loot** (v0.16.0): once you've signed up and the raid's instances are picked, a button on the raid shows your reserves and opens the Loot page on it.
- **Several instances a night, or to be decided** (v0.14.0): officers change a night's instances any time with the chips next to its title on the Raids page. A night with Hyjal and Onyxia shows "Hyjal + Onyxia (40)", has **groups per instance** on the Groups page (chips pick which), and one reserve list on the Loot page with both raids' loot.

![A raid night with Hyjal and Onyxia; officers' instance chips by the title](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-multi.png)

- **Remove from a raid** (v0.16.4): right-click a name in a raid's list → *Remove from this raid*; officers can remove anyone, everyone can remove their own characters (e.g. an alt signed up by mistake).
- **Away days** (v0.11.0): click the first day you're away on the Calendar, pick the last one under **Until** (e.g. 10-14 Dec; v0.16.0) and press **I'm away**; right-click marks a single day. It counts for all your characters and answers *Can't come* for you to every raid on those days, including raids made later (v0.16.4; signing up again afterwards sticks). Officers see "away" on the calendar, in the line-up, in the groups and in the planner's Away column (the next three months, as date ranges).
- **Groups** (v0.11.0): the raid as groups of five, with **Available** and **Bench** beside them. Everyone sees the groups ("You're in group 3"). Officers drag a name into a group, onto the Bench or back to Available (or click, then click where it goes); a full group swaps the two players; right-click marks **late**, **leaving early** or **absent**.
  - **Auto-fill** fills the empty spots from the sign-ups (signed up before tentative, then attendance and item level), with enough tanks and healers, healers spread over the groups and nobody marked away. What's already placed stays.
  - **Invite & arrange** (while leading the group) invites everyone In who's online, makes it a raid, invites the rest and moves everyone into their group. Press it again after each step: the game only makes a raid on a button press.

![Groups: eight groups of five, Available and Bench](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-groups.png)

![Groups on a Hyjal + Onyxia night: chips choose the instance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-groups-multi.png)

- **Assignments** (v0.11.0): officers add a boss (a name they type, or "Trash") and jobs from a list (Main tank, Off tank, Tank healer, Raid healer, Interrupt, Dispel, Decurse, Kite, Cooldowns, Soak, Marks, Pull), each with up to five players; **Copy last raid** brings the last raid's jobs over. Everyone sees them, and your own jobs show on the Raids page.

![Assignments: bosses, jobs and who does them](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-assign.png)

**Officer tools.** Officers, raid leaders, loot masters (v0.16.6) and the
Guild Master (any rank whose name has "Officer", "Raid Leader" or "Loot
Master" in it, and the rank "Addon Jesus") type
`/sr officer` to switch on the officer tools (per character; type it again to
switch them off): making raids on the Calendar, Attendance, and the Roster's
Officers view. For anyone else the command just prints the help. Every
player's game checks the rank of whoever made a raid, so nobody else can
make or cancel one.

- **Making a raid:** click a day on the Calendar (above). Cancel a raid from its ··· menu.

![Attendance for one raid: on time, late, no-show, tentative, can't come, bench and changed sign-ups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-attendance.png)

- **Attendance** (v0.14.0) is taken **automatically at each raid's start time**, no raid group needed: everyone who signed up (or is tentative) and is **online at the start** is **On time**; online within 15 minutes is **Late**; signed up and not online by then is a **No-show**. Tentative players who didn't come and people who said *Can't come* are listed without counting against them. Any officer's or raid leader's game that's online at the start does it (the more of them, the surer). **Bench** is ticked for people the officers had on the Bench who were online; click a name to tick or untick it.
- **Changed sign-ups:** when someone changes from *Signed up* to *Tentative* or *Can't come*, the addon remembers when. The raid's list shows how long before the start ("5h before", orange within 24 hours).
- Raids recorded before v0.14.0 (in the raid group) still show as they were.

![Attendance totals per person](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/raids-totals.png)

- **Totals** per person over 30, 60 or 90 days, or all: raids, on time, late, **no-shows**, bench, **changed** (sign-ups changed away from Signed up, out of the raids they signed up for), **<24h** (of those, changed in the last 24 hours) and attended %.
- **Every officer sees it** (v0.8.1): when a raid's check ends, or Bench is ticked or unticked, the record goes by whisper to the officers and raid leaders online with the addon; officers who were offline get it when they log in. The tab says who recorded each raid. Members never receive attendance. Everything stays in the addon: there's no spreadsheet export.

### 🎲 Loot (Reserve+)

![Loot page: tonight's raid, its loot with your points, and who reserved what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/loot.png)

The guild's TBC loot system, built in (v0.9.0). You
**soft reserve** items for a raid night. Every night you were there (or on
the bench and online when reserves were locked) and didn't get a reserved
item, that item gains **bonus points** (+10 to start; officers set it). Your
points are added to your `/roll` the next time you reserve it. **No cap**:
reserve the same trinket for months and nobody new can take it from you.
`/sr loot` opens the page.

- **Points belong to one character and one item.** Switch to another item and it starts from 0; your old item keeps its points for when you go back to it. Only tonight's reserves count. Winning an item sets its points to 0. Alts don't share.
- **Reserves:** pick tonight's raid, click an item (your points on each are shown), **Reserve this**. Officers set how many reserves each raid allows (1 until set); two on the same item give double points, still one roll. Everyone sees who reserved what, until and after an officer locks reserves.
- **Points:** yours, with *why* each number is what it is (night by night), and everyone's (searchable).
- **History:** every change, who made it and why: night bonuses, wins, changes by hand, moves, rule changes. Kept by everyone.
- **Rolls:** reservers always beat everyone else; among them the highest *roll + points* wins; equal totals go to whoever has more points, then a re-roll. Only the first 1–100 roll of each player counts.
- **Items by name** (v0.14.1), with their icon and quality colour, in name order, also while the game doesn't hold an item yet (Forever adds raid loot when the raid opens): the loot list carries each item's name, icon and slot. Hover an item for the game's own tooltip, or for its slot and a note that details may still change.
- **Item tooltips** on a raid night: "Reserve+: Reserved by 3: Cat 120, Bob 30, Dan" (in your bags, the loot window, AtlasLoot…).
- **Reminders** (v0.9.1), with a **Reserve** button: a calm one at login when you're signed up for a raid this week without your reserves, and an orange one on raid day (from 00:01, and when you join tonight's raid group) that comes back every 30 minutes. Both stop once you've reserved or an officer locks reserves. Reserve before going in: sharing pauses inside instances.

![Reserve reminder boxes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/loot-reminder.png)

![Loot night: drops, rolls ranked by roll plus points, raid check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/loot-night.png)

**Officers** (with `/sr officer`; raid leaders, the Guild Master and the addon's creator count too) also get:

1. **The game's Encounter Journal**, if Forever turns it on for its raids: every player's addon reads the loot from it. `/sr debug` says whether it's on.
2. **warcraft.wiki.gg**: `tools/loot.js` reads each raid's loot page, finds the item IDs and checks them against Forever's own item data. ### 🧨 Everywhere
- **Open it** with `/sr` (or `/shortroyalty`, `/sk`) or the **minimap button** (our crest): left-click opens the window, right-click opens Settings, drag to move it.

Each page has its title and one sentence saying what it's for. One **accent colour** (pink by default) marks where you are, what you picked and the one main button; orange is only for alerts.
- **Profession reminder bar:** until you've opened each of your crafting profession windows once (that's when your recipes are recorded), an orange bar sits under the page title on **every** page: "Your guild can't see your recipes yet. Open your Alchemy and Tailoring windows once." Its **Open Alchemy** button opens that window for you (not in combat), then the next one, and the bar goes away by itself when all are done. The window grows by the bar's height, so nothing on the pages moves. No bar if you chose not to share recipes.

![Profession reminder bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/main/docs/images/reminder.png)

- **The window** opens on the Overview the first time, then on your last page. Drag it by the crest or the page title; it remembers where you left it. **Esc** closes it.
- **Automatic collection** on every character you play: gear, item level, talents, reputations, professions, recipes (when you open the profession window), cooldowns, attunements and your other characters.
- **"Crafted by" on item tooltips:** hover any item to see "Short Royalty: Bramble (online), Dabble +2 more". Online crafters first, at most three names. Two lines at most, with who wears it, plus who reserved it on a raid night (v0.9.0).
- **A welcome line** the first time Short Royalty loads, pointing to *Getting started*.
- **Chat reminders** for profession windows still to open (and, rarely, ones to reopen after your skill went up), a newer Short Royalty, and trial accounts that can't share.
- **`/sr debug`** opens a copyable report of what the addon can see, starting with the live-client checks and the profession checks for v0.3 (unlearned recipes, recipe categories, reagents, specialisations), and ending with the last Lua errors it caught. Failed sends are listed by kind (channel, message, the game's reason) with the last few and who they were for. **Send it when something looks wrong.**

### 🔒 Under the hood
- **Your own data always wins.** A copy relayed by someone else never overwrites a newer copy from the character themselves.
- **Light on the network.** Only small fingerprints are broadcast; full profiles are whispered to whoever needs them, rate-limited so nobody is disconnected.
- **Careful with what it receives.** Nothing received is ever run as code. Messages from people outside the guild aren't even opened; oversized ones (over 32 KB, or over 256 KB unpacked) are refused; every field of every profile is checked before it's stored; a stranger can't pass themselves off as a guildmate who shares their first name; and no guildmate can flood you (60 messages a minute each, and senders of repeated bad messages are ignored until `/reload`). Details: [docs/SECURITY-REVIEW.md](https://github.com/EllisKOsborn/forever-shortroyalty/blob/main/docs/SECURITY-REVIEW.md).
- **Built from pinned sources.** The release zip is built by GitHub Actions pinned to exact commits, and the bundled libraries are byte-for-byte the upstream files.
- **Stays out of your way.** Sync pauses in combat, in every kind of instance and whenever the game locks addon chat. It stops messaging guildmates who have logged off, and hides the game's "No player named … is currently playing" when the addon caused it (v0.8.2). The window is safe to open in combat.
- **Private where it matters.** Notes, officer notes, gold, bags and chat are never sent. You choose whether gear and recipes are shared.
- **Tidies up.** Members who leave are forgotten 30 days later.

1. Download **`ShortRoyalty-vX.Y.Z-forever.zip`** from

   > **Not "Source code (zip)".** GitHub adds those links to every release.

2. Unzip it. You get a folder called **`ShortRoyalty`**. (Tried an early
   test build called `ShortKings`? Delete that old folder.)
3. Move that folder into your Forever **AddOns** folder:

   🍎 **Mac**
   ```
   /Applications/World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/
   ```
   🪟 **Windows**
   ```
   C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\
   ```

4. Restart the game. *Short Royalty* is listed under **AddOns** on the character screen.

> [!TIP]
> **Can't find the folder?** In the Battle.net app, pick **WoW Forever**,
> click the **⚙** next to Play, then **Show in Finder** (Mac) or **Show in

## ❓ FAQ

**Someone shows no data. Why?**

They don't have Short Royalty, haven't logged in since installing it, or are on
a **trial account** (trial accounts can't send addon messages). From the
outside the addon can't tell these apart, so it says all three.

**My alt is missing, or isn't grouped under my main.**

The game only lets an addon read the character you're logged in as, so log in
on each alt once. Alts are linked only when **both** characters have done
that (so nobody can claim someone else as their alt). Your highest-level
character is shown first as the main.

**Can I keep my gear or recipes private?**

Yes. In **Settings**, untick *Share my gear and talents* or *Share my recipes
and cooldowns*. Guildmates then see "hidden by this player"; you still see
your own. Name, level and profession levels are always shared, as the guild
roster shows them anyway. Notes and officer notes are never sent.

**My recipes aren't showing.**

Open that profession's window once. Until then the Character tab says "not
scanned yet". After that your full recipe list is shared, you appear in
**Crafters**, and your name shows on tooltips of items you can make. Open it
again after learning new recipes.
